name: World Link Internet (Gold Coast)
summary: Gold Coast dialup ISP (worldlink.com.au, no hyphen; local content, ~1995-96); defunct ~2000. NOTE: distinct from Adelaide's World-Link (world-link.com.au) (S M K MARKETING PTY. LTD. (t/a World Link Internet Services; also t/a Netsperts Internet Services), ACN 006 933 704).

refs.label: ABR: S M K MARKETING PTY. LTD. (t/a World Link Internet Services; also t/a Netsperts Internet Services)
ISP's own 1997 Terms & Conditions name the operating company and its ACN (the printed '066 933 704' is checksum-invalid - typo for 006 933 704).
ABR's sole 'SMK Marketing' company record matches; ABN Lookup rejects '066933704' as an invalid ACN, consistent with a typo on the terms page.
